scientific_review: Published NetCDF source55,152,138bytes verified against Zenodo version5851312 MD5; raw SHA retained. Only the EAC file was downloaded; raw source file not redistributed. All field processing used one idle cloud CPU.

Source file metadata confirms northward-positive m/s velocities, metre positive-down depth coordinate and192 months January2004–December2019. One regional nominal transect is not a full current route.
Source axis integration and five-point triangular filter are implemented, with additional OSW identity gate151–157E. All192 selected axes are inside the gate; none is relocated to force identity.
All12 monthly means retain fixed16-profile support per retained depth. Core,0/5/10cm/s crossings, native brackets, gaps, edge maxima and right-censored cases remain separately typed.

Nine cloud tests cover integration weights, sign-specific axis, adjacent crossing, missing gaps, censoring versus threshold not reached, shallow edges/ties, unknown poleward core, fixed seasonal contributors and strict JSON nonfinite handling.

Physical uncertainty from reference velocity, structural reconstruction, averaging and threshold choice is not reduced to a fabricated depth confidence interval. No statistical seasonal significance or whole-current thickness/volume is claimed.
